hero.h1: Free Nano Banana Pro AI Image Generator — No Sign Up
hero.desc: Create from a prompt or edit with up to 8 reference images. Choose 1K, 2K, or 4K output, set the frame for your project, and export in the format you need.

modelIntro.title: What Is Nano Banana Pro?
description: Nano Banana Pro is Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 Pro Image model for generating and editing images from text and reference images. It is built for visuals where accurate in-image text, multilingual creative, subject consistency, and real-world context matter as much as style.

Use it for posters, product concepts, infographics, and reference-guided scenes that need a clearer visual brief than text alone. On Toolaze, start from a prompt or add reference images to direct the subject, composition, and visual treatment.

featureStories.title: Key Features of Nano Banana Pro
featureStories.description: Nano Banana Pro combines multilingual in-image text, reference consistency, visual reasoning, and output up to 4K.

items.title: Multilingual In-Image Text
paragraphs: Nano Banana Pro is designed to generate legible text directly in the image, from a short headline to more detailed copy. It can also render text in multiple languages, so the typography can be part of the image direction rather than an afterthought.

Use it for posters, packaging concepts, mockups, and social creative where the visual and its message need to arrive together. Keep exact production copy for your design file, but use the generated result to evaluate hierarchy, language treatment, type style, and layout in one frame.

media.alt: An editorial poster concept generated with a large legible headline integrated into the image

items.title: Reference Consistency
paragraphs: The model is designed to preserve the resemblance and visual relationship of people and other supplied elements in complex compositions. On Toolaze, you can guide one request with up to eight reference images for the subject, wardrobe, setting, palette, or visual treatment.

That makes it a stronger starting point for campaigns and narrative concepts where a person, product, or visual identity needs to remain recognizable while the scene, lighting, styling, or composition changes.

media.alt: A reference-guided character scene with a consistent subject, wardrobe direction, and cinematic setting

items.title: Visual Reasoning
paragraphs: Nano Banana Pro combines Gemini reasoning with image generation for context-rich visuals, including diagrams, infographics, and product compositions built from several supplied directions. On Toolaze, add up to eight references when the result needs to connect product details, materials, palette, styling, and layout cues.

Use it to turn an information-heavy brief into a visual explanation or develop a detailed campaign composition before production. Choose 1K, 2K, or 4K for the generated output; 4K gives you a larger file for closer review, not a lossless upgrade of a low-detail reference.

media.alt: A multi-reference product composition with material, palette, styling, and layout cues combined in one scene

items.title: Up to 4K Output
paragraphs: Choose 1K, 2K, or 4K output before generating. The 4K option gives you a larger image file when the concept needs closer inspection of product textures, small visual details, or in-image typography.

Use 4K for detailed campaign comps, product concepts, and information-led layouts that may move beyond a small social preview. Select the output size before you generate, then review the larger result in the same workflow.

media.alt: Toolaze Nano Banana Pro output controls with 4K selected

howToUse.title: How to Use Nano Banana Pro

steps.title: Choose a Creation Mode
steps.desc: Use Text to Image for a new concept, or Image to Image when you want references to guide the result.

steps.title: Write the Brief and Add References
steps.desc: Describe the subject, setting, composition, and visual direction. For reference-guided work, upload up to 8 JPG, PNG, or WebP images.

steps.title: Set Output and Generate
steps.desc: Choose a ratio, select 1K, 2K, or 4K, pick an output format, then generate, review, and download your image.

promptExamples.title: Nano Banana Pro Prompt Examples
promptExamples.subtitle: Use these as a starting point, then add your own references when the subject, product, or style needs closer direction.

items.title: Editorial Product Launch
items.prompt: A premium fragrance bottle on pale travertine, early morning window light, soft shadows, warm ivory and sage color palette, high-end editorial product photography, generous negative space for a headline

items.title: Poster With Clear Information Hierarchy
items.prompt: A contemporary museum exhibition poster for an imaginary design festival, bold geometric forms, balanced grid, dark navy background with coral accents, large readable English title: FORM / FUTURE, refined editorial typography

items.title: Reference-Guided Fashion Concept
items.prompt: Use the uploaded references for the silhouette, fabric mood, and studio lighting. Create a full-length fashion campaign image of one model in a clean sculptural set, composed for a 4:5 magazine cover, natural skin texture, understated styling

items.title: Cinematic Travel Still
items.prompt: A quiet coastal train platform at blue hour, one traveler in a mustard coat, wind moving through tall grass, wide cinematic framing, subtle film grain, cool ocean haze, realistic atmospheric lighting

modelComparison.title: Nano Banana Pro vs Nano Banana 2
modelComparison.subtitle: Choose Nano Banana Pro when eight focused references and standard production ratios are enough. Choose Nano Banana 2 when the brief needs more references or extra ultra-wide and ultra-tall formats.

rows.label: Aspect-ratio range
rows.baseline: Common portrait, landscape, square, and 21:9 ratios.
rows.target: The same core ratios plus 1:4, 4:1, 1:8, and 8:1.

rows.label: Starting Credits
rows.target: 15 Credits at 1K; 24 Credits at 2K; 36 Credits at 4K.

rows.label: When to choose it
rows.baseline: Choose Pro for a focused reference set of up to eight images and standard production ratios.
rows.target: Choose Nano Banana 2 for a reference-heavy workflow or extra ultra-wide and ultra-tall ratio options.

scenes.title: Product Launch Creative Direction
scenes.desc: Upload a product shot, palette, and styling references, then describe the set, lighting, and copy space you want for a campaign concept.

scenes.title: Text-Led Poster Concepts
scenes.desc: Start with a title, theme, and visual direction to shape a poster or cover concept, then select the ratio that fits the final placement.

scenes.title: Reference-Guided Character Frames
scenes.desc: Use one reference for the character and others for wardrobe, setting, and mood to direct a new scene or storyboard-style frame.

faq.q: Is Nano Banana Pro free to use?
faq.a: Yes. You can start using Nano Banana Pro on Toolaze for free.

faq.q: Do I need to sign up to use Nano Banana Pro?
faq.a: No. You can start the Nano Banana Pro generator without signing up.

faq.q: Which image files can I upload?
faq.a: Nano Banana Pro accepts JPG, PNG, and WebP reference images. You can upload up to 8 images, with a maximum file size of 30MB per image.

faq.q: Can I choose the output format?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Auto, PNG, JPEG, or WebP before generating when you need a specific export format.

faq.q: What do 1K, 2K, and 4K cost on Toolaze?
faq.a: Nano Banana Pro uses 24 Credits for 1K or 2K output and 42 Credits for 4K output.

faq.q: When should I choose Nano Banana 2 instead?
faq.a: Choose Nano Banana 2 when you need to work with more than 8 reference images or want its additional 1:4, 4:1, 1:8, and 8:1 ratio options.
